newsitem.title: UK: UK end-June wheat stocks 1.84 mln tns - HGCA.
newsitem.headline: UK end-June wheat stocks 1.84 mln tns - HGCA.

text.p: United Kingdom wheat stocks were nearly 1.84 million tonnes at the end of June, the end of the 1996-97 season, according to the Home Grown Cereals Authority.
"Last year's record wheat harvest was supplemented by large carryover stocks on farm," according to the HGCA, which released the latest supply and demand estimates on Wednesday.

Stocks of barley were over one million tonnes, the HGCA said. "Exports rose by some two-thirds from the 1995-96 level, helping to absorb last year's larger crop," the HGCA said. "However a five per cent decline in domestic use left an end-season stock some 200,000 tonnes above domestic needs."

The HGCA put end season stocks of wheat at 1.836 million tonnes, compared with 1.804 million at the end of 1995-96. End-season stocks of barley were put at 1.034 million tonnes, compared with 872,000 a year earlier.
